attchmntText: Ajax Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about herewith the copies of newspaper advertisement, published in Financial Express (English Newspaper) and Vishwavani (Kannada Newspaper) on Sunday, i.e. November 15, 2026, confirming the dispatch of the notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Ajax Engineering Limited published a newspaper advertisement on November 15, 2026, confirming the dispatch of a Postal Ballot Notice. The advertisement appeared in Financial Express and Vishwavani. Eita India Limited reported standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 171.42 lakh on standalone basis and Rs. 175.86 lakh on consolidated basis. Nivaka Fashions Limited proposed voluntary delisting of equity shares from Metropolitan Stock Exchange of India Limited and Calcutta Stock Exchange only. The proposal was approved by the Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. Shares will continue to remain listed on BSE Limited.

attchmntText: Ajax Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Ajax Engineering Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 6, 2026. Total revenue for Q2 FY27 was INR487 crores, up 9.5% year-on-year. SLCM revenue grew 5.9% to INR395.8 crores. Non-SLCM revenue surged 64.7% to INR55.8 crores. Profit after tax for the quarter rose 30.4% to INR50.9 crores. For H1 FY27, total revenue reached INR961.5 crores, a 5.5% increase. SLCM revenue grew 3.3% to INR783.5 crores. Non-SLCM revenue increased 31.5% to INR103.5 crores. Profit after tax for the half-year grew 16% to INR106.5 crores. The company reported a cash balance of INR1,151 crores. SLCM market share expanded to 75.5% in H1 FY27. Export revenue grew 47% year-on-year. The company noted rising raw material costs and implemented price hikes.

attchmntText: Ajax Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Ajax Engineering Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for the appointment of Mr. Shishir Joshipura, DIN 00574970, as a Non-Executive Independent Director. The resolution is placed for approval via remote e-voting through CDSL. The voting period commences on Sunday, 15 November 2026, at 9.00 a.m. IST and ends on Monday, 14 December 2026, at 5.00 p.m. IST. The cut-off date for eligibility is Friday, 06 November 2026. Mr. Pramod S M or Mr. Biswajit Ghosh of M/s. BMP & Co. LLP has been appointed as the Scrutinizer. The results of the postal ballot are expected to be announced on or before Wednesday, 16 December 2026. The appointment, if approved, would be for a term of five years from 17th September 2026 to 16th September 2031.
